title: Throw the right exception type
prompt: Implement `int validate_line(const std::string& line)` interpreting the line as a non-negative integer: throw `std::invalid_argument` for an empty line, a leading '-', or any non-digit; throw `std::out_of_range` when the parsed value exceeds 100; otherwise return the value.

tests.name: invalid-arg
tests.hint: A leading '-' is invalid_argument, not out_of_range.

tests.name: out-of-range
tests.hint: 101 parses but leaves the domain: out_of_range.

tests.name: exact-type
tests.hint: Type discipline: 'abc' must land in invalid_argument.
